faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.cta_text: Bring your garden to life with expert care and eco-friendly solutions. Our team of trained gardeners is ready to handle everything from routine maintenance.

items.q: How often should I schedule lawn maintenance?
items.a: It depends on your lawn type and needs, but generally weekly or bi-weekly maintenance keeps your outdoor space healthy and looking its best.

items.q: What are the benefits of aerating my lawn?
items.a: Aeration relieves soil compaction, improves water and nutrient absorption, encourages deeper root growth, and leads to a thicker, healthier lawn.

items.q: When is the best time to fertilize my lawn?
items.a: For most grasses, spring and autumn are ideal. Spring fertilizing jumpstarts growth while autumn applications strengthen roots before winter.

items.q: How can I control weeds in my lawn?
items.a: Regular mowing, proper watering, and dense healthy turf are the best natural defenses. We also offer selective weed-control treatments.

items.q: What type of grass is best for my climate?
items.a: This depends on your region and sun exposure. Our experts will assess your garden and recommend the most suitable grass variety during the free consultation.
